title: Separate offline synthetic schema-shape probes
execution_scope: Draft 2020-12 schema + FormatChecker only; individually invented records; no semantic bundle validator, production TypeScript validator, research artifact code, original acceptance cases or live data executed

results.purpose: Metadata-only source without source-body hash
results.interpretation: Proposal source artifact hash is optional. This does not satisfy production sourceItem hash requirements.

results.purpose: Organization actor with unknown geographic/identity details
results.interpretation: Empty unknown-details arrays are shape-valid; no identity is verified.

results.purpose: Institution-attributed statement
results.interpretation: Proposal speaker_refs accepts an actor-shaped reference; production statement still needs person_slug.

results.purpose: Incident with unidentified subjects and unassessed severity
results.interpretation: Empty subject_refs and unknown severity are shape-valid; event taxonomy/cluster/rubric here are wholly fictional.

results.purpose: Candidate count with exact decimal string and reported mode
results.interpretation: A resource_kind other shape can represent the invented count, but semantic suitability is not established.

results.purpose: Unsupported native artifact ID field
results.interpretation: Closed source-artifact data requires a sidecar or reviewed upstream crosswalk, not invented fields.

errors.message: Additional properties are not allowed ('source_native_identifier' was unexpected)

results.purpose: Unsupported authority field
results.interpretation: No native typed authority_status field in statement data.

errors.message: Additional properties are not allowed ('authority_status' was unexpected)

results.purpose: Source-inspection label is not incident verification enum
results.interpretation: Source inspection must not be silently rewritten as confirmed incident.

results.purpose: JSON number rather than exact decimal string
results.interpretation: Numerical result values require base-10 strings.

errors.message: {'kind': 'point', 'value': 7, 'unit': 'count'} is not valid under any of the given schemas

results.purpose: Bound without inclusivity
results.interpretation: Bounds need explicit inclusivity; this still cannot establish a scientifically appropriate bound.

errors.message: {'kind': 'upper_bound', 'bound': '17', 'unit': 'count'} is not valid under any of the given schemas

results.purpose: Syntactically complete count bound
results.interpretation: Shape validity does not determine whether incomplete ascertainment permits an upper bound.

results.purpose: Explicit unknown source date
results.interpretation: Unknown source date is representable without invented precision.

results.purpose: Month-only string forced into exact-date type
results.interpretation: Use a supported precision-aware range or explicit unknown, retaining the source label.

errors.message: {'kind': 'date', 'date': '2001-02'} is not valid under any of the given schemas

results.purpose: Date-only system retrieval timestamp
results.interpretation: System timestamps cannot be supplied by a calendar date alone.

results.purpose: Source-native count unit outside unit enum
results.interpretation: Unit count plus metric definition/context retains source-specific objects; custom unit strings are not allowed.

errors.message: {'kind': 'point', 'value': '7', 'unit': 'websites'} is not valid under any of the given schemas

results.purpose: Legal compliance relation outside statement enum
results.interpretation: Preserve richer native relationships in sidecars.

results.purpose: Cross-record supersession passes shape
results.interpretation: Static validator reading says same-ID immediate-prior revision is separately required; semantic validator was not executed.

results.purpose: Local label is not repository URN
results.interpretation: Do not treat deliverable-local IDs as canonical record IDs.

results.purpose: Resource observation lacking a measured subject
results.interpretation: Do not insert the regulator publisher as measured subject to satisfy the schema.

results.purpose: Source artifact with unknown title omitted
results.interpretation: Complete proposal artifact requires a source title; artifact type is not a truthful substitute.

results.purpose: Eligible publication with unknown rights passes shape
results.interpretation: Static validator reading identifies publication/content-rights gates; schema-only acceptance is not clearance.

results.purpose: Human-verified label without reviewer passes shape
results.interpretation: Static validator reading requires reviewer and reviewed_at; neither was tested by the semantic validator.

results.purpose: Wrong reference target type passes structural reference shape
results.interpretation: x-target-types annotations require separate semantic checks; actual target lookup is not performed here.

results.purpose: Unsupported factual promotion uses valid enum values
results.interpretation: Schema cannot determine whether invented confirmation/causality claims are supported; no factual verdict follows.

results.purpose: Invalid order-to-performance inference in free text
results.interpretation: Shape validation does not adjudicate this deliberately misleading fictional inference. Manual semantic review must reject it.

results.purpose: Reverse time interval passes shape
results.interpretation: Static validator reading identifies a time_range invariant; semantic validator was not executed.

results.purpose: Additional legal-date role in closed times object
results.interpretation: Signature/filing/issuance/effectiveness roles need preserved source-native sidecars.

errors.message: Additional properties are not allowed ('signed' was unexpected)

results.purpose: Explicit missing measurement
results.interpretation: Missingness is not zero or failed remediation.

results.purpose: Null result is not tagged missingness
results.interpretation: Use a supported missing reason; do not interpret null as zero.

errors.message: None is not valid under any of the given schemas

results.purpose: Dependent repetition relation
results.interpretation: Repeats is representable after evidence review; repeated documents do not become independent events.

results.purpose: Typed numerator denominator fields absent from measurement
results.interpretation: Metric definition/scope can describe units; structured native pairing remains a sidecar.

errors.message: Additional properties are not allowed ('denominator', 'numerator' were unexpected)

results.purpose: Per-component rights field absent from governance
results.interpretation: Mixed-source/component rights must stay separately scoped; a single record rights state is not lossless.

errors.message: Additional properties are not allowed ('third_party_rights' was unexpected)

limits: Accept means only schema shape accepted. It does not verify record references, identity, rights, authority, evidence, event counts, causal attribution, cohort joins, truthful metrics or outcome completion.
Accepted deliberately misleading fictional records demonstrate validation limits, never successful native admission.
Static observations about validate_dataset.py are documented separately; it was not imported or run.
All original 20 acceptance cases remain not_executed with runtime_result null.
